patch_description: Combines the stronger midpoint-guided detour insertion from the crossover program with a more compact flat-cell implementation. The rewritten solver precomputes adjacency and APSP paths using cell IDs, reduces coordinate/wall lookup overhead during repeated scoring, and retains the simulated annealing operators including shortest-path replacement, reversal, targeted insertion, and target-guided local rerouting. Targeted detours explicitly test the midpoint of the largest revisit gap, which improves placement of additional visits for high dirt-contribution cells.
